lines.text: Momentum Meet-up: Networking Mixer for Students
Build real-world connections with peers, alumni, and local employers
at our campus-wide mixer!
Join us on Tuesday, April 14, 5:00–7:00 P.M. in the Student
Center Ballroom.
The evening features fast-paced speed-networking
rounds, a short alumni insights panel, and open
mingling—perfect for practicing introductions and
discovering internships.
• Arrive at 4:45 P.M. for a quick networking primer led by
Career Services.
• Be prepared to share five to ten copies of your résumé.
• Smart casual attire is encouraged.
• Light refreshments provided.
• Name tags and conversation starters will be provided at check-in.
• All majors and class years welcome, including graduate students.
Hosted by Career Services and Student Government, Momentum
Meet-up is a friendly, low-pressure space to grow your professional
network and learn how to follow up the right way.
Come for the conversation; leave with contacts.
RSVP by April 10 at www.momentummeetup.dreyer.edu.
